title: Diana Flores and Under Armour Champion the Next Generation of Flag Football Athletes with the Third Annual UA Next Flag Football Camp
summary: Diana Flores and Under Armour joined forces to inspire the next generation of athletes in Mexico; Valentina Rico and Andrea Quintanar de la Garza, the two MVPs of the camp, will have access to future UA Next events
body_markdown:
“Flag football has the power to transform lives"


"Days like these are a reminder of why I love this sport. Having the opportunity to share the field with young athletes who dream of representing Mexico inspires me to keep competing and pushing to help grow the game. This camp is about more than sport—it’s about showing the next generation that their dreams are possible.”


Diana Flores


Captain and Quarterback of the Mexican Women’s National Flag Football Team, and Under Armour Global Ambassador
